allowed_origins.docs:
**list of strings**: A list of origins that browsers are allowed to make cross-origin requests from. See [Cross-Origin Requests](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#cross-origin-requests) for details. Each entry must exactly match the requesting page's `Origin` header (e.g. `https://app.esphome.io`). A single `"*"` entry (quoted, since an unquoted `*` is invalid YAML) allows any origin, but this is not recommended.

*See also: [Web Server Component](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#configuration-variables)*

password.docs:
**string**: The password to check for authentication.

*See also: [Web Server Component](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#configuration-variables)*

basic.docs: Sends the password in an easily reversible (Base64) form on every request.

digest.docs: Sends only hashes, keeping the password off the network. Recommended.

type.docs:
**string**: The HTTP authentication scheme. Both show the same login prompt in the browser; the difference is on the network. One of:

*See also: [Web Server Component](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#configuration-variables)*

username.docs:
**string**: The username to use for authentication.

*See also: [Web Server Component](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#configuration-variables)*

auth.docs:
Enables HTTP authentication with a username and password.

*See also: [Web Server Component](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#configuration-variables)*

compression.docs:
**string**: The compression algorithm used for embedded web assets when `local` is enabled. Options are `gzip` or `br` (Brotli). Brotli provides smaller embedded web assets (~10% smaller than gzip), but some browsers only support Brotli over HTTPS connections. Since ESPHome devices typically serve over HTTP, gzip is recommended for maximum compatibility. Defaults to `gzip`.

*See also: [Web Server Component](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#configuration-variables)*

css_include.docs:
**local file**: Path to local file to be included in web server index page. Contents of this file will be served as `/0.css` and used as CSS stylesheet by internal webserver. Useful when building device without internet access, where you want to use built-in AP and webserver.

*See also: [Web Server Component](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#configuration-variables)*

css_url.docs:
**url**: The URL that should be used for the CSS stylesheet. Defaults to [https://oi.esphome.io/v1/webserver-v1.min.css](https://oi.esphome.io/v1/webserver-v1.min.css) (updates will go to `v2`, `v3`, etc). Can be set to empty string.

*See also: [Web Server Component](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#configuration-variables)*

enable_private_network_access.docs:
**boolean**: Enables support for [Private Network Access](https://wicg.github.io/private-network-access) and the [Private Network Access Permission Prompt](https://wicg.github.io/private-network-access/#permission-prompt). When enabled, preflight requests are authorized against `allowed_origins`, so `allowed_origins` must also be set. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Web Server Component](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [Web Server OTA Updates](https://esphome.io/components/ota/web_server#configuration-variables)*

include_internal.docs:
**boolean**: Whether `internal` entities should be displayed on the web interface. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Web Server Component](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#configuration-variables)*

js_include.docs:
**local file**: Path to local file to be included in web server index page. Contents of this file will be served as `/0.js` and used as JS script by internal webserver. Useful when building device without internet access, where you want to use built-in AP and webserver.

*See also: [Web Server Component](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#configuration-variables)*

js_url.docs:
**url**: The URL that should be used for the JS script. Defaults to [https://oi.esphome.io/v1/webserver-v1.min.js](https://oi.esphome.io/v1/webserver-v1.min.js). Can be set to empty string.

*See also: [Web Server Component](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#configuration-variables)*

local.docs:
**boolean**: Include supporting javascript locally allowing it to work without internet access. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Web Server Component](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#configuration-variables)*

log.docs:
**boolean**: Turn on or off the log feature inside the web server. When enabled, the device also streams logs over the `/events` endpoint, so [`esphome logs`](https://esphome.io/guides/cli/#logs-command) can view logs over the network on devices that have no [native API](https://esphome.io/components/api/) configured. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [Web Server Component](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#configuration-variables)*

ota.docs:
**boolean**: Explicitly disable OTA updates through the web server interface. Only accepts `false`. This option is typically used when you have both `web_server` and `captive_portal` configured, and you want OTA updates to be available only through the captive portal. Since `captive_portal` automatically loads the web server OTA platform, setting this to `false` prevents OTA access through the regular web interface while maintaining it for captive portal access. To enable OTA for web server, use the `web_server` OTA platform instead.

*See also: [Web Server Component](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#configuration-variables)*

port.docs:
**int**: The port the web server should open its socket on.

*See also: [Web Server Component](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for the group.

*See also: [Web Server Component](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#configuration-variables)*

name.docs:
**string**: A string representing the group name which is displayed as the header of the group

*See also: [Web Server Component](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#configuration-variables)*

sorting_weight.docs:
**float**: A float representing the weight of the group. A group with a smaller

*See also: [Web Server Component](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#configuration-variables)*

sorting_groups.docs:
**list**: Available only on `version: 3`. A list of group ID's and names to group the entities. See [Webserver Entity Grouping](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#config-webserver-grouping).

*See also: [Web Server Component](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#configuration-variables)*

version.docs:
**string**: `1`, `2` or `3`. Version 1 displays as a table. Version 2 uses web components and has more functionality. Version 3 uses HA-Styling. Defaults to `2`. Version 1 is deprecated and will be removed in 2027.1.0; please migrate to version 2 (the default) or version 3.

*See also: [Web Server Component](https://esphome.io/components/web_server#configuration-variables)*
